title: Consistent AI Sprite Sheet + Animation Generator
author: PilotOk7725
selftext: Hey all! I'm quite new to this, but I've been working on an AI Sprite Generator for my own game dev (and the people I tutor). As some of you may know, one of the biggest pain points in AI Sprite/Animation generation is ensuring character consistency (something I've personally struggled with)**.** As a result, I started experimenting with a workflow focusing on consistency across generated sprites and animations, rather than just one-off animations. After a lot of iteration, it’s gotten to a point where it’s saving me a huge amount of time during development. I figured others might be interested in it, so I've decided to create a mockup landing page to test this! As you may guess, I'm posting this here to see if anybody is indeed interested/or wants to test. If so please either DM me or join the waitlist on the website. I want to start rolling out free usage to the people who signed up next week or so and gather some feedback! Also, if anyone has any questions I'd be happy to answer! Warm regards!
